full_prompt_en: A square, intimate color photograph brings a young face extremely close to the camera, half screened by sunlit leaves and bright out-of-focus points. The face occupies almost the entire frame, so the setting appears only as layered patches of deep blue, warm gold, and red at the edges. One eye on the left side is sharply visible beneath a dark brow, looking directly toward the viewer. The other eye is partially hidden behind a veil of translucent foliage and reflected light near the upper right. Warm side light reaches the bridge and tip of the nose, the cheek, and a narrow area around the mouth. Shadows pass over the forehead and across one side of the face, giving the close view a mottled, shifting appearance. The lips are closed and relaxed, while the gaze remains steady and quiet. Brown hair blends into the upper and right margins, catching a few narrow glints of light. In the foreground, soft cream-colored circles and small bright beads blur across the cheek and lower center. Fine stems and tiny flower-like specks overlap the right side of the face, some sharply outlined and others lost in shallow focus. A deep blue opening at the upper right contrasts with the amber haze and dark facial shadows. Near the lower edge, the image falls into richer reddish brown and green, with no clearly defined clothing or surface to distract from the face. The color has a lightly grainy photographic quality, not a painted or evenly retouched finish. Strong low warm light arrives from the right and above, breaking into scattered highlights as it passes through nearby growth; the dark patches retain soft edges rather than hard studio shadows. No text is visible. The overall composition is dreamy yet direct, turning foliage, shallow focus, and fluctuating gold light into a translucent layer over an unwavering close gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、亲密的彩色照片：年轻人的脸极近镜头，一半被阳光照亮的叶片和明亮失焦光点遮住。面部几乎占满画框，环境只在边缘表现为深蓝、暖金和红色的层叠色块。左侧一只眼睛在深眉下清楚可见，直望观看者。另一只眼睛部分藏在右上方半透明叶丛和反光的薄幕之后。暖侧光落在鼻梁与鼻尖、脸颊和嘴周围的窄小区域。阴影掠过额头与脸的一侧，让近景呈现斑驳、流动的外观。嘴唇放松地闭着，目光却稳定而安静。褐发融入上缘与右缘，捕捉到几道细窄亮光。前景里，柔和的奶油色圆点和小亮珠模糊地横过脸颊与下方中央。纤细茎秆和小花状亮点在脸右侧交叠，有的轮廓较清楚，有的消失在浅景深中。右上角一块深蓝色空隙对照琥珀色薄雾和面部深影。靠近下边缘，色彩沉入更浓的红褐与绿色，那里没有清楚界定的服饰或表面来分散对脸的注意。色彩带着轻微颗粒的摄影质感，而非绘画或均匀修饰的完成面。强烈而偏低的暖光从右上进入，穿过近处植物时裂成散落高光；暗斑的边缘保持柔软，而不是硬质影棚投影。画中没有文字。整体构图梦幻却直率，让叶丛、浅景深和起伏的金色光线在坚定的近距离目光前形成半透明层次。
style_prompt_en: Intimate color photography layers a sharply held focal plane with translucent foreground blur and scattered bright bokeh. Warm amber highlights break across deep brown shadows, while occasional cool blue passages give the glowing color room to breathe. Nearby small forms interrupt the central area as soft circles, thin lines, and partial veils; some edges are precise and others dissolve into shallow focus. Low directional light passes through intervening material, producing mottled illumination rather than an even wash. A fine grain and natural tonal variation preserve a spontaneous, tactile image. The overall effect is immersive and dreamlike, with a direct focal presence held inside shifting color and light.
style_prompt_zh: 亲密的彩色摄影把清楚的焦平面与半透明前景虚化、散落的明亮散景叠在一起。暖琥珀高光在深褐阴影间破开，偶尔出现的冷蓝色通道给发亮的暖色留下呼吸空间。靠近镜头的小形体以柔圆斑、细线和局部薄幕打断中央区域；一些边缘准确，另一些溶入浅景深。偏低的定向光穿过遮挡物，形成斑驳照明，而非均匀色洗。细微颗粒和自然明暗变化保留随性的可触质地。整体效果沉浸、梦幻，让直接的视觉焦点稳立在流动的色光之中。
theme_en: A close face seen through golden foliage and shifting sunlight
theme_zh: 近距离面庞透过金色叶丛与流动日光显现
name: Ryan McGinley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
